events.title: New Modelpack System is finally here!
events.summary: Figure Drawing Garden just got a massive update. The new Modelpack System lets you dynamically load custom 3D models for your studies, and a new Modelpack Creator project means you can build your own Modelpacks right now too. Maybe classical sculptures aren't your cup of tea, you want a fun break from study, or maybe you just really want to draw dinosaurs, mech, or anime characters. events.title: ❄️ Winter Comes to Figure Drawing Garden — December Mini Update
events.summary: Just a very small December update adding some holiday theming. This release was mainly about getting seasonal events working for the future, but if you download the latest demo on Gamejolt / Itch right now - you’ll find the ponds frozen, snow falling, and some festive music until the end of December.In addition, the Human Scans model pack has received a few new additions. Just open the Model Packs tab and enable Human Scans to check them out.Happy holidays!

events.title: Devlog: Where Did the Idea Come From?
events.summary: Remember during the pandemic everyone started a "lockdown project"? — Mine was a video game to practice drawing. Well it's now 2025, and my “lockdown project” is finally starting to take shape, so I thought it's about time I made the first devlog for — Figure Drawing Garden.ORIGIN OF THE IDEA...Back in 2020, before the world came to a complete stop, I was on Erasmus in Paris, studying animation at Gobelins L'École de L’Image.
